CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_LEGALENTITYCUSTOMER_CRM
AS
BEGIN
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityCustomer AS(
	SELECT
		BCC.CORP_KEY AS CustomerId
		,BCC.CORPORATE_NAME AS LegalEntityName
		,NULL AS LegalEntityNote
		,BCC.DATE_OF_INCORPORATION AS LegalEntityDateOfEstablishment
		,NULL AS StateOfLegalEntityEstablishment
		,BCC.COUNTRYOFPRINCIPALOPERATION AS CountryOfLegalEntityEstablishment
		,BCC.REGION AS StateOfLegalEntityResidence
		,BCC.COUNTRYOFORIGIN AS CountryOfLegalEntityResidence
		,NULL AS CurrentManagementFirstControlDate
		,NULL AS FirstDateOfOperation
		,BCC.NAME_EXCHANGE AS StockExchangeName
		,BCC.STRUSERFIELD21 AS ListedSecuritySymbol
		,NULL AS TaxExemptCertificateStatement
		,NULL AS BankruptcyIndicator
		,NULL AS SmallBusinessIndicator
		,NULL AS ManufacturingIndicator
		,BCC.STRUSERFIELD12 AS ForeignOwnedIndicator
		,NULL AS DunsNumber
		,NULL AS DunBradstreetSingleLocationSubsidiary
		,NULL AS DunBradstreetHeadquarters
		,NULL AS DunBradstreetBranch
		,NULL AS DunBradstreetDivision
		,NULL AS DunBradstreetSubsidiary
		,NULL AS DunBradstreetParent
		,NULL AS DunBradstreetUltimate
		,NULL AS DunBradstreetGlobalUltimate
		,BCC.LEGALENTITY_TYPE_CODE AS LegalEntityFormId
		,NULL AS NaicsNationalIndustryCode
		,BCC.SUBSECTOR AS SicIndustryCode
		,BCC.LINE_OF_ACTIVITY_DESC AS AnzsicClassCode
		,BCC.SECTOR AS SectorCode
		,BCF.STR7 AS SMEClassification
		,BCC.SHORT_NAME AS ShortName
		,BCC.STRUSERFIELD1 AS FormerName
		,BCCDBA.NAME AS DoingAsBusinessName
		,BCC.KEYCONTACT_PERSONNAME AS KeyContactPersonName
		,BCC.BUSINESS_TYPE AS BusinessTypeId
		,BCC.STRUSERFIELD6 AS Top20000
		,BCC.PRINCIPLE_PLACEOPERATION AS PrincipalPlaceOfOperation
		,BCC.PRIMARYPARENTCOMPANY AS PrimaryParentCompany
		,BCC.COUNTRYOFPRINCIPALOPERATION AS PrincipleCountryOfOperation
		,BCC.INSIDERTOBANK AS Dosri
		,BCC.INSIDERROLE AS DosriTypeId
		,BCC.SEGMENT AS CorporateSegment
		,BCC.WEBSITE_ADDRESS AS Website
		,BCC.STRUSERFIELD22 AS RelatedPartyIndicator
		,BCC.STRUSERFIELD23 AS RelatedPartyTypeId
		,BCC.STR1 AS FATCAIndicator
		,BCC.STRUSERFIELD26 AS FATCAType
		,'CRM' AS SourceCode
		,BCC.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
		,BCCD.RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.CRM_CORPORATE_DELTA BCCD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.CRM_CORPORATE BCC ON BCCD.CORP_ID = BCC.CORP_ID AND BCCD.BANK_ID = BCC.BANK_ID AND BCC.isLatest = '1'
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.CRM_FINANCIAL BCF ON BCC.CORP_KEY = BCF.ORGKEY AND BCC.isLatest = '1'
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.CRM_CORPDBAINFO BCCDBA ON BCCDBA.CORP_KEY = BCC.CORP_KEY AND BCC.isLatest = '1'
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityCustomer FROM TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityCustomer;


-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityCustomer_SRC AS (
	SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
									CustomerId
									,LegalEntityName
									,LegalEntityDateOfEstablishment
									,CountryOfLegalEntityEstablishment
									,StateOfLegalEntityResidence
									,CountryOfLegalEntityResidence
									,StockExchangeName
									,ListedSecuritySymbol
									,ForeignOwnedIndicator
									,LegalEntityFormId
									,SicIndustryCode
									,AnzsicClassCode
									,SectorCode
									,SMEClassification
									,ShortName
									,FormerName
									,DoingAsBusinessName
									,KeyContactPersonName
									,BusinessTypeId
									,Top20000
									,PrincipalPlaceOfOperation
									,PrimaryParentCompany
									,PrincipleCountryOfOperation
									,Dosri
									,DosriTypeId
									,CorporateSegment
									,Website
									,RelatedPartyIndicator
									,RelatedPartyTypeId
									,FATCAIndicator
									,FATCAType)) AS HASHROW
		,CustomerId
		,RECORD_STATUS 
	FROM #TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityCustomer WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)


,
TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityCustomer_TGT AS (
	SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
									CustomerId
									,LegalEntityName
									,LegalEntityDateOfEstablishment
									,CountryOfLegalEntityEstablishment
									,StateOfLegalEntityResidence
									,CountryOfLegalEntityResidence
									,StockExchangeName
									,ListedSecuritySymbol
									,ForeignOwnedIndicator
									,LegalEntityFormId
									,SicIndustryCode
									,AnzsicClassCode
									,SectorCode
									,SMEClassification
									,ShortName
									,FormerName
									,DoingAsBusinessName
									,KeyContactPersonName
									,BusinessTypeId
									,Top20000
									,PrincipalPlaceOfOperation
									,PrimaryParentCompany
									,PrincipleCountryOfOperation
									,Dosri
									,DosriTypeId
									,CorporateSegment
									,Website
									,RelatedPartyIndicator
									,RelatedPartyTypeId
									,FATCAIndicator
									,FATCAType)) AS HASHROW
		,CustomerId
	FROM BNKM.LegalEntityCustomer
--WHERE SOURCE_CODE = 'CRM'
)


,
TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityCustomer_DELTA AS (
	SELECT	
		SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
		,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
		,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
		,CASE
			WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
		ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	FROM TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityCustomer_SRC	SRC
	FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityCustomer_TGT	TGT
	ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
	WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityCustomer_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityCustomer_DELTA;


---------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
[CustomerId] = SRC.CustomerId
,[LegalEntityName] = SRC.LegalEntityName
,[LegalEntityNote] = NULL
,[LegalEntityDateOfEstablishment] = SRC.LegalEntityDateOfEstablishment
,[StateOfLegalEntityEstablishment] = NULL
,[CountryOfLegalEntityEstablishment] = SRC.CountryOfLegalEntityEstablishment
,[StateOfLegalEntityResidence] = SRC.StateOfLegalEntityResidence
,[CountryOfLegalEntityResidence] = SRC.CountryOfLegalEntityResidence
,[CurrentManagementFirstControlDate] = NULL
,[FirstDateOfOperation] = NULL
,[StockExchangeName] = SRC.StockExchangeName
,[ListedSecuritySymbol] = SRC.ListedSecuritySymbol
,[TaxExemptCertificateStatement] = NULL
,[BankruptcyIndicator] = NULL
,[SmallBusinessIndicator] = NULL
,[ManufacturingIndicator] = NULL
,[ForeignOwnedIndicator] = SRC.ForeignOwnedIndicator
,[DunsNumber] = NULL
,[DunBradstreetSingleLocationSubsidiary] = NULL
,[DunBradstreetHeadquarters] = NULL
,[DunBradstreetBranch] = NULL
,[DunBradstreetDivision] = NULL
,[DunBradstreetSubsidiary] = NULL
,[DunBradstreetParent] = NULL
,[DunBradstreetUltimate] = NULL
,[DunBradstreetGlobalUltimate] = NULL
,[LegalEntityFormId] = SRC.LegalEntityFormId
,[NaicsNationalIndustryCode] = NULL
,[SicIndustryCode] = SRC.SicIndustryCode
,[AnzsicClassCode] = SRC.AnzsicClassCode
,[SectorCode] = SRC.SectorCode
,[SMEClassification] = SRC.SMEClassification
,[ShortName] = SRC.ShortName
,[FormerName] = SRC.FormerName
,[DoingAsBusinessName] = SRC.DoingAsBusinessName
,[KeyContactPersonName] = SRC.KeyContactPersonName
,[BusinessTypeId] = SRC.BusinessTypeId
,[Top20000] = SRC.Top20000
,[PrincipalPlaceOfOperation] = SRC.PrincipalPlaceOfOperation
,[PrimaryParentCompany] = SRC.PrimaryParentCompany
,[PrincipleCountryOfOperation] = SRC.PrincipleCountryOfOperation
,[Dosri] = SRC.Dosri
,[DosriTypeId] = SRC.DosriTypeId
,[CorporateSegment] = SRC.CorporateSegment
,[Website] = SRC.Website
,[RelatedPartyIndicator] = SRC.RelatedPartyIndicator
,[RelatedPartyTypeId] = SRC.RelatedPartyTypeId
,[FATCAIndicator] = SRC.FATCAIndicator
,[FATCAType] = SRC.FATCAType
,[SourceCode] = 'CRM'
,[FinancialInstitutionId] = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
,[WorkFlowId] = 0
,[TaskRunId] = 0
,[InsertDttm] = SRC.InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.LegalEntityCustomer TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityCustomer_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityCustomer SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId ;


-------INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.LegalEntityCustomer (
	[CustomerId]
	,[LegalEntityName]
	,[LegalEntityNote]
	,[LegalEntityDateOfEstablishment]
	,[StateOfLegalEntityEstablishment]
	,[CountryOfLegalEntityEstablishment]
	,[StateOfLegalEntityResidence]
	,[CountryOfLegalEntityResidence]
	,[CurrentManagementFirstControlDate]
	,[FirstDateOfOperation]
	,[StockExchangeName]
	,[ListedSecuritySymbol]
	,[TaxExemptCertificateStatement]
	,[BankruptcyIndicator]
	,[SmallBusinessIndicator]
	,[ManufacturingIndicator]
	,[ForeignOwnedIndicator]
	,[DunsNumber]
	,[DunBradstreetSingleLocationSubsidiary]
	,[DunBradstreetHeadquarters]
	,[DunBradstreetBranch]
	,[DunBradstreetDivision]
	,[DunBradstreetSubsidiary]
	,[DunBradstreetParent]
	,[DunBradstreetUltimate]
	,[DunBradstreetGlobalUltimate]
	,[LegalEntityFormId]
	,[NaicsNationalIndustryCode]
	,[SicIndustryCode]
	,[AnzsicClassCode]
	,[SectorCode]
	,[SMEClassification]
	,[ShortName]
	,[FormerName]
	,[DoingAsBusinessName]
	,[KeyContactPersonName]
	,[BusinessTypeId]
	,[Top20000]
	,[PrincipalPlaceOfOperation]
	,[PrimaryParentCompany]
	,[PrincipleCountryOfOperation]
	,[Dosri]
	,[DosriTypeId]
	,[CorporateSegment]
	,[Website]
	,[RelatedPartyIndicator]
	,[RelatedPartyTypeId]
	,[FATCAIndicator]
	,[FATCAType]
	,[SourceCode]
	,[FinancialInstitutionId]
	,[WorkFlowId]
	,[TaskRunId]
	,[InsertDttm])

SELECT     
	[CustomerId]
	,[LegalEntityName]
	,[LegalEntityNote]
	,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,LegalEntityDateOfEstablishment)) AS LegalEntityDateOfEstablishment
	,[StateOfLegalEntityEstablishment]
	,[CountryOfLegalEntityEstablishment]
	,[StateOfLegalEntityResidence]
	,[CountryOfLegalEntityResidence]
	,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,CurrentManagementFirstControlDate)) AS CurrentManagementFirstControlDat
	,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,FirstDateOfOperation)) AS FirstDateOfOperation
	,[StockExchangeName]
	,[ListedSecuritySymbol]
	,[TaxExemptCertificateStatement]
	,[BankruptcyIndicator]
	,[SmallBusinessIndicator]
	,[ManufacturingIndicator]
	,[ForeignOwnedIndicator]
	,[DunsNumber]
	,[DunBradstreetSingleLocationSubsidiary]
	,[DunBradstreetHeadquarters]
	,[DunBradstreetBranch]
	,[DunBradstreetDivision]
	,[DunBradstreetSubsidiary]
	,[DunBradstreetParent]
	,[DunBradstreetUltimate]
	,[DunBradstreetGlobalUltimate]
	,[LegalEntityFormId]
	,[NaicsNationalIndustryCode]
	,[SicIndustryCode]
	,[AnzsicClassCode]
	,[SectorCode]
	,[SMEClassification]
	,[ShortName]
	,[FormerName]
	,[DoingAsBusinessName]
	,[KeyContactPersonName]
	,[BusinessTypeId]
	,[Top20000]
	,[PrincipalPlaceOfOperation]
	,[PrimaryParentCompany]
	,[PrincipleCountryOfOperation]
	,[Dosri]
	,[DosriTypeId]
	,[CorporateSegment]
	,[Website]
	,[RelatedPartyIndicator]
	,[RelatedPartyTypeId]
	,[FATCAIndicator]
	,[FATCAType]
	,[SourceCode]
	,[FinancialInstitutionId]
	,[WorkFlowId]
	,[TaskRunId]
	,[InsertDttm]
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityCustomer
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');


DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityCustomer;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityCustomer_DELTA;

END
